spans.s: nom. ˚धक् (√ दह् Desid.), wishing to burn, Vop. iii, 151.
दिध˚क्षा f. desire to burn, MBh.; BhP.
दिध˚क्षु mfn. desirous of burning, MBh.; R.; BhP.
firmness, stability, W.

1. दीधी (connected with √ 2. दी) cl. 2. Ā. दीधीते, to shine, be bright, Dhātup. xxiv, 68;
 P. अ॑दीधेत्, 3. pl. अदीधयुर्, to appear as, resemble (nom.), RV. v, 40, 5; x, 98, 7.

2. दीधी (cf. √ 1. धी and √ ध्यै) cl. 2. Ā. दिधीते, 1. sg. दीध्ये (RV. v, 33, 1), p. Pres. दी॑ध्यत् (RV. ii, 20, 1) and दी॑ध्यान (RV., often with मनसा) to perceive, think, be intent upon;
to wish, desire.
nom. ˚धिक् (√ दिह् Desid.) wishing to smear, Vop. iii, 151.
‘to be gained’, to be sought to be sought (Agni), RV. ii, 4, 1 (= धारयितृ, supporter, Sāy.)
wishing to gain or obtain, striving after, seeking, RV.
a suitor, RV. x, 18, 8
a husband, BhP. ix, 9, 34
the second husband of a woman twice married (also ˚षू), L.
(उ or ऊ), f. a widow remarried or an elder sister married after the younger (both of whom having the choice of their husbands may be compared to suitors).
= दिधिषू, L. See दिधिषु
दिधि˚षू-पति m. the husband of a woman so married, Kāṭh. xxxi, 7; Gaut.; Vas.
दिधि˚षूपपति m. her paramour, MBh. xii, 1211. (Cf. अग्रे-दिधिषु and एदिधिषुः-पति.)
the wish to hold or support, Bālar. i, 48.
1. दी॑धिति f. brightness, splendour, light, a ray, Naigh. i, 5; MBh.; Kālid. &c.
majesty, power, Bhartṛ. ii, 2
N. of works., esp. ifc.
2. दी॑धिति f. religious reflection, devotion, inspiration, RV. i, 186, 11 &c.
दीधिति—प्रकाश m. N. of Comm.
दीधिति—प्रत्यक्ष-टीका f. N. of Comm.
दीधिति—माथुरी f. N. of Comm.
दीधिति—मत् mfn. having splendour, shining, brilliant, ŚāṅkhGṛ. vi, 3
दीधिति—मत् m. the sun, Kum. ii, 2; vii, 10
N. of a Muni, Kathās. lix, 93.
दीधिति—रौद्री f. N. of wk.
दीधिति—व्याख्या f. N. of wk.
